quest.title: The Great Tree
quest.description: A student named Yasmin seems very concerned about the state of the Divine Tree before her.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Looks like it does need some proper care...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: You are... Huh. Judging by your looks, you must be a traveler, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I'm Yasmin, a student from Amurta. I'm here to study the Divine Tree.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: The years this Divine Tree has seen exceed the total amount of rice grains contained in all the pilaf in Port Ormos.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: It also holds the Akademiya up. It can be said to be as important as the vegetables at the bottom of Tandoori Roast Chicken.

choices.text: What kind of simile is this...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: If anything untoward were to happen to it, Sumeru City in its entirety would face terrible disasters.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: It might be harried by pests, or locusts bigger than a roof might rush out from the inside...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Or the branches might go into a growing frenzy, and the roots might sprout outward like floods from the earth, destroying every house in its path.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Or maybe the Divine Tree might wither so very quickly that its trunk falls on half of Sumeru City, crushing everything there...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Th—Those things aren't really gonna happen, right!?

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Oh, of course. Or at least, everything has been totally fine so far.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: But then again, it's not like the fungal beasts will warn you in advance before attacking you while you gather mushrooms in the forests.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: That's why I'm here: to observe the tree and prepare for any incidents that might come our way.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: But as you can see, my thoughts are as swift as a Dusk Bird, yet my strength is as feeble as a Starshroom.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: So, Traveler, could you help me record the condition of the Divine Tree's roots at a few locations?

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Usually, I hire adventurers to go with me, but no one seems to have been available this time around...

choices.text: Do you researchers all talk like that...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Eh? Are you referring to the similes I'm using? Sorry about that. It's just how I talk...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: People in the Akademiya have also talked to me about this, but I can't just change at the drop of a hat!

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: I'm counting on you this time. I'll be waiting for you here.

choices.text: This is your kind of analogy, eh, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, it is a great tree indeed...

talks.objective: Go to the roots of the Divine Tree

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Traveler, what a coincidence. We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still doing your research?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Yes. Ladep and Pharez requested more data, so here I am, continuing my work.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: That said, I wonder how those roots are doing right now...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you would, please help me record the conditions of the Divine Tree roots once again.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I'm counting on you this time. I'll be waiting for you here.

talks.objective: Record the condition of the roots

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: You're back. How are the Divine Tree roots?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the condition of the roots to Yasmin...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: ...Oh, if there are living creatures gathered there, then the area should still be full of vitality.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: That means that the roots of the Divine Tree should be able to grow steadily without any serious problems for now.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: The only concern... is the possible eutrophication of the surrounding water bodies, which might nourish more Fungi...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Anyway, here's your payment. Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: We'd best have Ladep and Pharez monitor the concentration of elements nearby...
